title: Lake Lure Washburn Marina
specs: Beach surrounded by Blue Ridge Mountains
Guided tours include legends and natural and cultural history of Hickory Nut Gorge
Pontoon boats seat up to 13 passengers
Children 16 and under must be accompanied by an adult at the beach
North Carolina requires boaters age 25 and younger to complete Boater Safety Training Course before operating a vessel
Group rates available for beach admission (20+ people) and guided boat tours (10+ people)
Private charters available for guided boat tours for weddings, corporate events, family reunions

blurb: Guests can rent motorized pontoon boats and non-motorized kayaks to explore Lake Lure. Guided boat tours offer scenic trips around the lake with commentary on local history and legends. The Lake Lure Beach provides a place to relax, swim, and enjoy an adventure course.
extraNote: No refunds due to bad weather at the beach · Tickets for guided boat tours sold first-come, first-served starting at 10 am the day of the tour · All rentals must be returned 30 minutes prior to closing · Pets not permitted on rental boats or tour boats · Groups of 20+ receive $1 off beach admission per person if paid in single transaction · 2930 Memorial Highway, Lake Lure, NC · Boat rentals available Memorial Day through Labor Day; Beach open weekends in 2026
